proposal.name: Reap orphaned processes in the plumbing sandbox

plan.name: Reap orphaned processes in the plumbing sandbox
plan.summary: Run every plumbing sandbox container with Docker's --init so an init process reaps orphaned children, keeping every other container and runner setting unchanged. Add an acceptance test that checks the launch options without Docker and, when INVARIANT_PLUMBING_INIT_REAL=1, runs a Go test in the pinned sandbox image that kills a child after its parent exits and requires kill(pid, 0) to report that the process is gone. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe the init process and document the real-image test command, retaining the existing sandbox decisions as citations, including D-0110, D-0117, D-0189 and D-0281, and D-0122 for keeping the docs current. The decision to use --init has not yet been recorded; whoever merges this change records it and adds its citation to the sandbox documentation. Decision recording and the real-image check, when Docker or image acquisition is unavailable, belong under Merger work.

tests.name: TestSandboxReapsOrphanedProcesses
tests.says: The sandbox launches Docker with --init alongside its existing isolation settings; the opt-in real-image run verifies that a sandboxed Go test sees a killed orphan disappear instead of remain a zombie.

usage.summary: Wrote plan.json and its acceptance test for `--init`, orphan reaping, and sandbox documentation updates. Check 1 of 4 passed: the plan is valid, and the acceptance test fails on the unchanged base as required.
